items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: Herbert, I think Herbert Lindsay married one.

ctx.x: Well, since he isn't here anymore, we'll never get all those facts from him. Are his sisters, any of them living? Do you think? Are they all dead?

I think one sister's living. She's in Chicago. He kept her married one. Is that right? I don't know if he married, but Herbert, I think Herbert Lindsay married one. Herbert Lindsay married one. Well he married the dark one or the light one. Oh no, you got me now.
See? He had two sisters, three sisters.
